lead: Yonkers plumbing deals with steep hills, older multi-family homes and cold winters. PipeMend sends licensed local plumbers across Yonkers.
risk: old galvanized and lead pipes, frozen pipes and riser leaks in apartment buildings
risk_short: old pipes, frozen pipes and riser leaks
why: Getty Square, Park Hill and Ludlow have homes and apartment buildings from the 1890s to the 1940s with galvanized supply lines, cast-iron stacks and lead service lines in some cases.
Steep streets make sewer and water lines long and hard to reach. Winter cold freezes pipes near exterior walls, and shared risers in apartment buildings leak.
water: Yonkers gets its water from New York City's Catskill and Delaware reservoirs. It is very soft.
tips: Know where each unit's shutoff is.
Check building rules before plumbing work.
Scope the sewer lateral before buying.
areas: PipeMend works in Getty Square, Park Hill, Crestwood, Lincoln Park, Ludlow, Northwest Yonkers and every other Yonkers neighborhood.
permits: Plumbing permits come from the Yonkers Department of Housing and Buildings, which also licenses plumbers in the city. New York has no statewide plumber license.

faq.q: Where does Yonkers get its water?
faq.a: Yonkers buys water from New York City's upstate Catskill and Delaware reservoirs. It is very soft, so scale is rare.
